verdict.rationale: The axis applies, since Perplexity offers agentic task features (Assistant, Computer, Agent API), but nothing in the evidence shows versioning, review or rollback of automations. The only related item is that Agent API profiles are 'versioned' configurations, which is an adjacent feature: no review or rollback is documented, and profiles are not shown to be automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
